business_summary: Newegg Commerce, Inc. operates as an electronics-focused e-retailer in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company sells desktops, laptops, gaming laptops, peripherals, and accessories; CPU/processors, graphic cards, motherboards, storage devices, and computer accessories; and software, virtual reality, gaming consoles, networking, digital games, home appliances, gaming desks/chairs, and TVs. It provides supply chain third-party services, such as Shipped by Newegg, offers warehousing and fulfillment services; Newegg Logistics, provides warehousing, inventory management, order processing, packing, and shipping; and Newegg Staffing, offers clerical, manufacturing, and logistics employee placement. In addition, the company operates B2C platforms, including Newegg.com, an online e-commerce platform; Newegg.ca, an e-commerce platform focusing on IT/CE products; and Newegg Global, as well as mobile apps; and B2B platforms comprising NeweggBusiness.com. It sells its products under the Asus, MSI, HP, Lenovo, Acer, Microsoft, Samsung, LG, Gigabyte, Logitech, Intel, AMD, MSI, Corsair, ASRock, Western Digital, Seagate, G.Skill, Meta, PlayStation, Dyson, Netgear, Nintendo, H&R Block, and Adobe brands. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Diamond Bar, California. Newegg Commerce, Inc. is a subsidiary of Digital Grid (Hong Kong) Technology Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Newegg Commerce, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다 및 국제적으로 전자제품 중심의 전자 소매업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 데스크탑, 노트북, 게임용 노트북, 주변 장치 및 액세서리를 판매합니다. CPU/프로세서, 그래픽 카드, 마더보드, 저장 장치 및 컴퓨터 액세서리; 소프트웨어, 가상 현실, 게임 콘솔, 네트워킹, 디지털 게임, 가전 제품, 게임 책상/의자, TV 등이 있습니다. Shipped by Newegg와 같은 공급망 제3자 서비스를 제공하고 창고 보관 및 주문 처리 서비스를 제공합니다. Newegg Logistics는 창고 보관, 재고 관리, 주문 처리, 포장 및 배송 서비스를 제공합니다. Newegg Staffing은 사무, 제조 및 물류 직원 배치를 제공합니다. 또한 온라인 전자상거래 플랫폼인 Newegg.com을 포함한 B2C 플랫폼을 운영하고 있습니다. IT/CE 제품에 초점을 맞춘 전자상거래 플랫폼 Newegg.ca Newegg Global 및 모바일 앱; NeweggBusiness.com으로 구성된 B2B 플랫폼. Asus, MSI, HP, Lenovo, Acer, Microsoft, Samsung, LG, Gigabyte, Logitech, Intel, AMD, MSI, Corsair, ASRock, Western Digital, Seagate, G.Skill, Meta, PlayStation, Dyson, Netgear, Nintendo, H&R로 제품을 판매합니다.
